## RELATED PRODUCT BRANDS

[Labeling & Coding logo]
As a leading single source provider of high-quality labeling, coding, and marking systems, ProMach
designs, manufactures, and integrates custom identification solutions to ensure peak operational
efficiency. With advanced systems for applications in primary and secondary packaging, as well as
distribution and fulfillment environments, our solutions provide accurate labeling and coding on
virtually every substrate in every market.

## EXPLORE OTHER PROMACH BUSINESS LINES

ProMach is your partner from start to finish. Our product brands are grouped into distinct business
lines that make the most sense to our customers, covering every function of the production line:
Filling, Bottling & Capping, Decorative Labeling, Flexibles & Trays, Pharma, Handling & Sterilizing,
Labeling & Coding, Robotics & End of Line, and Systems & Integration.

# Nanometer‑class photonics positioning and direct optical fiber switching — designed for stability,
# low loss, and precision performance.

###### U Series Ultra Resolution
###### Nano Positioners

Luminos U Series Ultra Resolution Positioners integrate the Luminos designed ultra precise linear
stepping motor actuator to provide a highly stable, open loop, single layer system.

 

With industry leading 0.1um bi-directional backlash, and incremental move capability finer than
10nm, all without the need for Piezos, Luminos U Series Positioners far exceed SMF-28 waveguide
alignment requirements, allowing optimization within 0.01 dB without backlash compensation.

[LEARN MORE][48]

###### Photonics Integrated Circuit (PIC) Alignment

The Luminos Photonics Integrated Circuit (PIC) Alignment System provides a compact workstation
allowing up to four sided alignment for assembly of complex PIC devices.

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

## We supply high-performance label stock for printers worldwide

Our label materials are part of UPM Adhesive Materials. As one of the leading suppliers of
self-adhesive label stock globally, we offer you consistently high-quality label materials that
bring together performance and sustainability.

Whether you’re working with branded food packaging labels, durable industrial solutions or the
informative demands of logistics labeling, we deliver the right label material for you.

We are dedicated to your success and ready to connect with your ambition.

#### High-quality materials and adhesive expertise

#### Reliable service and collaboration

#### Innovative solutions for growing end-uses

### UPM Raflatac^{™}

[Discover the UPM Raflatac^{™} difference][3]
 

[Already a customer? Order in MyRaflatac][4]

[Send us an inquiry][5]

## UPM’s label material offering

Your success depends on reliable adhesive material performance. That is why we offer an extensive
range of pressure sensitive label stock for every end use and market segment. At the core is the
[**UPM Raflatac™**][6] line of premium label materials, the name you trust for quality, performance
and sustainability innovation across end uses. Supported by adhesive expertise, advanced materials
science and expert services, our premium offering helps you deliver consistent, reliable results for
your customers.

To complement these premium materials, [**UPM Intercoat™**][7] label materials provide
cost-competitive, dependable bulk solutions that balance performance and supply reliability with
cost efficiency. Together, UPM Raflatac™ and UPM Intercoat™ give you a full spectrum of label
material options so you can choose the right fit for every application, every customer and every
market segment. 

### Paper labels
* Coated and uncoated paper faces
* Gloss, matt and textured finishes
* White and colored papers
* Specialty papers

[Discover more][8]

### Film labels
* PP labels
* PE labels
* PET labels
* PVC labels

[Discover more][9]

### Adhesives
* Permanent
* Removable
* Wash-off

[Discover more][10]

### Direct thermal linerless labels
* Paper and film DT linerless labels
* DT linerless wash off labels

[Discover more][11]

### Sustainable label materials
* PCR labels
* Wash off labels
* Certified label materials
* Linerless labels

[Discover more][12]

### Sustainability services
* **Label Life**: Make more sustainable label choices with Label Life
* **RafCycle™**: Recycle label liner waste

[Discover more][13]

[Are you a customer? Order in MyRaflatac][14]

## Labels by industry

Our high-quality label products cater to various and growing end-uses. Whether you’re a printer,
designer or a brand, you can trust our materials to meet your needs.

## Industry leaders we’re proud to partner with

We’re proud to collaborate with leading printing and converting partners – take a look at some of
the companies we work with and what they have to say about working with UPM Adhesive Materials.

*“We partner with UPM Adhesive Materials because they don’t just supply materials – they are
interested in our success. Their ability to listen, respond, and bring new ideas to the table helps
us navigate the challenges of narrow web flexo and digital printing. By giving us reliable
substrates and genuine collaboration, they free us to focus on what we do best: delivering products
that exceed our customers’ expectations.”*

– **Jennifer Duckworth**, Procurement Manager

*“Our partnership with UPM Adhesive Materials is built on trust, innovation, and a shared commitment
to quality – a relationship that continues to strengthen and support our growth at Lattice Labels.”*

– **Tony Clifton**, Managing Director

*“UPM Adhesive Materials is a fantastic partner for our business. Their label materials are
reliable, high quality, and a great fit for our products. What really sets them apart is the support
we get. Whether it’s helping us choose the right material or troubleshooting an issue, they’re
always on it and easy to work with. Between the product quality and the level of service we get, UPM
Adhesive Materials has earned our trust.”*

– **Miranda Harrington**, General Manager

*“UPM is an outstanding partner for Abbott Label, consistently delivering excellent
service and high-quality products. Their reliability and commitment to supporting our business gives
us the confidence to meet our customers’ needs every day. We truly value UPM as a supplier we can
always count on.”*

– **John Abbott**, President

## Ведущий производитель термопринтеров AIYIN

Компания AIYIN была основана в 2015 году и находится в городе Сямынь, Китай. Мы производим первый
в Китае принтер этикеток профессионального класса.

Ориентируясь на потребности пользователей, мы занимаемся исследованиями и разработкой принтеров
для печати этикеток, термотрансферных принтеров, принтеров для печати чеков, принтеров для дома
и офиса, сканирующих терминалов, а также программного обеспечения для печати и облачных сервисов,
предоставляя безопасные и надёжные продукты и профессиональные решения для полнопроцессной печати.

Компания имеет штаб-квартиры в Сямэне и Шанхае, а также центры продаж и обслуживания по всему миру.

### Истории успеха

Используя удобные мобильные печатающие устройства, сотрудники склада могут распечатывать этикетки
на продукцию, отгрузочные документы, штрих-коды и т.д. в режиме реального времени, что позволяет
не тратить время на ожидание стационарного печатного оборудования и значительно повысить
эффективность работы

Автоматизация процесса создания и нанесения этикеток позволяет компаниям электронной коммерции
значительно ускорить доставку товаров и управление запасами, повышая при этом точность и сокращая
количество человеческих ошибок

Принтеры штрих-кодов AiYin помогают аэропортам повысить эффективность и точность обработки багажа,
снизить риск потери и недоставки багажа, а также ускорить процесс посадки пассажиров

### Глобальные партнёры

Мы наладили глубокое сотрудничество со многими известными мировыми брендами, чтобы помочь клиентам

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Should I use RFID, bar code or magnetic stripe card technology?

This depends on any existing or new systems you will be using along with your ID cards such as door
access systems, tracking and/or verification software, check-in/out programs, etc. CI Solutions will
find the card format that works with these systems and design an ID card that integrates RFID,
barcode, and/or magnetic stripe depending on what the card will be used for.

I need a new ID card design, can CI Solutions help me?

CI Solutions’ Graphics Team has designed cards for thousands of organizations. We can provide you
with multiple design and layout options based on your industry and brand.

What kind of card printer do I need to print my cards?

This depends on the type of card technology you are using (RFID and/or magstripe), if you are
printing on one or both sides of your cards, and if you are printing color or just black and white
text. CI Solutions offers pre-printed card stock and half-panel color ribbons to keep printing time
to a minimum as well as competitive pricing on the leading card printers in the market.

What kind of software do I need to print my cards?

Badge, our card printing software, allows you to easily print and enroll RFID cards. We will install
your card designs/layouts and train you on how to print cards.

Consult • Solve • Perform: that’s in our DNA. We solve problems, tackle compliance-intensive
specifications, design durable products and manufacture custom labels. Let’s get started.

[REQUEST A PROPOSAL][81]

## SPECIALIZED SOLUTIONS

From prototype runs to high-volume custom label orders, as one of the premier label and [die cut
adhesive][82] manufacturing companies in the US, we solve unique application requirements through
personalized consultation, technical prowess, and consistently excellent manufacturing performance.
* **GUARANTEED QUALITY**
  
  We are [ISO 9001:2015][83] certified. Because of this, if the product you receive doesn’t meet our
  agreed upon specifications, we’ll replace it for you at no charge.
* **ONLY THE BEST MATERIALS**
  
  We use only [industrial][84]-grade [materials][85] from the best suppliers in the world — Avery
  Dennison (Fasson), [3M][86], Polyonics, Spinnaker Coating, and others.
* ****MADE IN THE USA****
  
  We control the whole process, including [pre-media and platemaking][87], in our climate-controlled
  and fastidiously clean [manufacturing plant][88].

#### Join the Thousands of Companies Using Coast Label Company

[Lockheed Martin]
[Honda]
[kaiser permanente]

## OUR CORE FOCUS

Coast Label Company was founded on the principles of solving requirements through consultation and
technical prowess.

One way we carry that commitment forward to today is through our continuing education training
program. This keeps our team of Label Specialists on top of industry trends, evolving techniques,
and updated materials.  All the better to consult and develop the best solution and label for your
needs. Whether you need parts that are [clear][89], [waterproof][90], [durable][91], or another
custom label need such as [QR codes][92], we can make it happen for you.

[[About Coast Label]][93]

## WHY COAST LABEL

Guided by an [ISO 9001:2015][96] international quality system and having been a five-time winner of
TLMI’s prestigious Eugene Singer Award for Best Managed Company, you can rest assured knowing that
you are working with one of the premier label manufacturing companies in the industry. Using
state-of-the-art digital printers, flexographic presses, and custom die cutting equipment, we can
make your precision adhesive parts and labels consistently time and time again.

That said, at the end of the day we know your project is important, which is why we don’t expect you
to make your decision just by looking at our website. Please give us a call or email and learn for
yourself the Coast Label Difference with our experienced team of application specialist. To make
your decision even easier, we are so confident in the value we bring you that we offer free
consulting to prospects and customers. How can you afford not to take advantage of that opportunity?

## Over 6 Decades of Experience

#### Innovative and Reliable Label Solutions

Our distributors offer more than just an expansive selection of label products. We provide
innovative solutions to help make your business more productive and your life more organized.

Our products are manufactured for strength and durability to ensure they operate smoothly whether
you’re printing labels at home or on a commercial printing press

#### Customization to Meet Your Brand Needs

Our distributors know your label needs are not always ‘cut-and dry’. We can also print, manufacture
and package custom labels according to your unique specifications.

Your labels are an extension of your business branding and should reflect the sophistication and
success that defines your company. Our distributors understand this, which is why we offer the
ultimate in label and card customization services.

#### Committed to You
#### Every Step

Our distributors offer years of expertise and vast knowledge of label technologies to help you find
the right answers to best fit your needs with an unparalleled level of customer support.

We continue to bring exciting new products to help make everyday life run a little more smoothly. No
matter what advances the future may bring, we’ll be there for you every step of the way.

## 5 Locations Nationwide

Elgin, IL Redlands, CA Dallas, TX Duluth, GA Somerset, NJ

## Custom Labels

Enhance your products’ appeal and brand recognition with custom labels. We specialize in creating
stunning, high-quality labels that make your products pop and leave a lasting impression. Our custom
labels are crafted with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring your products shine brighter than
the competition.

### Adaptability

Your needs aren’t static, so you need labels ready for any situation. With custom labels, you have
the power to adapt and evolve your system as your requirements change, ensuring continued efficiency
and relevance.

### Durable Materials

Select from top-quality materials that ensure your labels maintain their integrity and look great,
even in challenging conditions.

### Custom Fit for Your Needs

Get labels precisely tailored to your specifications, enhancing both functionality and aesthetics.

### Superior Print Quality

Experience sharp, vibrant colors and crisp details that make your labels pop.

### Boost Your Appeal

Make a statement with professional, high-quality labels that enhance your brand’s image and
captivate your audience

### Proudly Made in the USA

Work with us today to make a lasting impression and elevate your brand. If you’d like to submit a
purchase order or custom quote request, email [sales@datalabel.com][54]

**DuraMark Technologies. Turning labels into real business solutions**

**DuraMark Technologies is not your ordinary label maker, and for a number of important**

**reasons. We do more than provide stickers, we deliver real business solutions that impact**

**everything from overhead and inventory costs to LEAN manufacturing to delivery schedules. **

 

**Because we know the impact our labels can have, we’re constantly innovating to deliver**

**smarter solutions and bigger ideas.**

**Watch and learn what sets DuraMark Technologies labels apart.**

**Durable, high-quality labels.**

Because our focus is on creating labels and decals for manufacturing and outdoor equipment,
durability, clarity, and adhesion are always top of mind. DuraMark’s proprietary, premium material
sandwich means superior fade resistance. Our labels stand the test of time, maintaining their
integrity for more than 10 years.

[ See what's behind a DuraMark label ][34]

**A faster, more flexible approach to**

** label production.**

DuraMark takes a 100% digital approach when it comes to printing. This creates crystal clear labels
and decals that go from art to finished part in minutes. Because we’re digital, we can respond
quickly to changes, whether it’s a new brand or a new ANSI requirement. And there are no minimums,
which is ideal for prototypes and smaller changes.

[ Find out more about the benefits of digital printing ][35]

 

***"DuraMark label kits have helped eliminate errors on our assembly floor."***

 

**- Haulotte / BilJax, Operations**

 

**Product-specific label kits reduce**

** inventory, mistakes, and delays.**

If you think of kitting as multiple label sheets stuck in a bag that creates confusion on the
production floor, you haven’t experienced DuraMark kitting. Our approach is streamlined, exacting,
and proven to reduce time and money.

[ Discover what sets DuraMark kitting apart ][36]

**Variable data printing. Greater ****flexibility, speed, and affordability.**

Many manufacturers require labels with specific, unique information like serial numbers, VIN
numbers, and asset numbers. These labels are critical to your operation and require variable
printing, in which elements are changed from one printed piece to the next. DuraMark’s innovation

and digital technology takes variable data to the next level.

[ Explore DuraMark's approach to variable data ][37]

# Australia's Best Online Food Ordering System & Takeaway Software for Restaurants

Foodship is a commission-free **online food ordering system for restaurants & cafes based out of
Australia**. A reservation management system made for your restaurant, an alternative to Menulog,
UberEats & DoorDash. A complete blend of every tool you need to operate your restaurant, or takeaway
joint successfully.

[][25]
[Website][26]

Free website & web hosting

[][27]
[Payment Options][28]

Multiple Payment Gateways

[][29]
[ORA][30]

App for Restaurant Staff

## Online Ordering Menu System

In Australia, many restaurant business use online food ordering system. Aren’t you? Foodship’s
Online Food Ordering System provides multiple ways to create & showcase your menu.
* **Simple Menu –** Menu for standalone food items with a simple add to cart button
* **Advanced –** For food items where customization is required for Eg Pizza or create your salad,
  sushi, etc. multiple levels with separate rules for each level for example – Force customer to
  select a certain number of food items or keep it optional or select a set minimum.
* **Half & Half Pizza –** For Pizza Ordering System, required by pizza stores generally where you
  allow your customer to choose 2 different kinds of pizza and make one, for example, half veg and
  half meat.
* **Combos –** Option to create combos by clubbing items together and sell for a special price. For
  example, select 3 items from 5 options for a discounted price.
* **Custom Availability– ** Sell a food item on a specific day of the week or at a specific time.
  Set a special price for a certain day.
[Online Table Reservation][Online Table Reservation]

## Online Table Reservation System

Foodship **Online Food Ordering System** also comes with a table reservation management system that
enables your customers to book a table online in your restaurant. Foodship Online Food Ordering
Platform connects the table reservation management system to your existing website of Australia also
available integrated with our free websites.

Foodship’s table reservation system can be connected to Google’s proprietary Book a Table button.
Restaurant’s customer sees this Book A Table button on a google search result and can directly land
to your table reservation system.  

Accept or Decline table reservation request in one click and manage from the admin panel or mobile
app. Send table reservation confirmation to the customer via email and SMS. 

[Foodship - Restaurant Gift Voucher System][Foodship - Restaurant Gift Voucher System]

## Restaurant Gift Card System

A proven method to [boost revenue][31] and increase cash flow for your business. Foodship’s
Restaurant Gift Card System allows you to create, sell, redeem, and manage gift cards. Customers can
buy gift cards from your food ordering website, gift them to friends and family and use it to buy
food online or dine-in customers. These Gift Cards can be redeemed on the Foodship [Restaurant POS
system][32] as well.
* **Retail Gift Card -** Create seasonal gift cards with custom amounts and look and feel. For eg a
  $50 value gift card and sell it for $ 45 on your website. Set expiry date, allow to use with
  online food orders , and dine in.
* **Complimentary Gift Card -** A proven way to retain unhappy customers. Use it to oblige unhappy
  customers or can be used as a method to refund some amount to the customer.
* **Redeem - **Customers can use the gift card for online food ordering, and you can also charge
  gift cards via the restaurant staff mobile app for Dine-In customers.
* **Manage -** Detailed reporting is available on the admin dashboard for Gift Card buyers and
  Redeemers.

  Set a special price for a certain day.
[Online Table Reservation][Online Table Reservation]

## Online Table Reservation System

Foodship **Online Food Ordering System** also comes with a table reservation management system that
enables your customers to book a table online in your restaurant. Foodship Online Food Ordering
Platform connects the table reservation management system to your existing website of Australia also
available integrated with our free websites.

Foodship’s table reservation system can be connected to Google’s proprietary Book a Table button.
Restaurant’s customer sees this Book A Table button on a google search result and can directly land
to your table reservation system.  

Accept or Decline table reservation request in one click and manage from the admin panel or mobile
app. Send table reservation confirmation to the customer via email and SMS. 

[Foodship - Restaurant Gift Voucher System][Foodship - Restaurant Gift Voucher System]

## Restaurant Gift Card System

A proven method to [boost revenue][31] and increase cash flow for your business. Foodship’s
Restaurant Gift Card System allows you to create, sell, redeem, and manage gift cards. Customers can
buy gift cards from your food ordering website, gift them to friends and family and use it to buy
food online or dine-in customers. These Gift Cards can be redeemed on the Foodship [Restaurant POS
system][32] as well.
* **Retail Gift Card -** Create seasonal gift cards with custom amounts and look and feel. For eg a
  $50 value gift card and sell it for $ 45 on your website. Set expiry date, allow to use with
  online food orders , and dine in.
* **Complimentary Gift Card -** A proven way to retain unhappy customers. Use it to oblige unhappy
  customers or can be used as a method to refund some amount to the customer.
* **Redeem - **Customers can use the gift card for online food ordering, and you can also charge
  gift cards via the restaurant staff mobile app for Dine-In customers.
* **Manage -** Detailed reporting is available on the admin dashboard for Gift Card buyers and
  Redeemers.

[Foodship - Contactless Table Ordering System][Foodship - Contactless Table Ordering System]

## Contactless Table Ordering System

Foodship Online Food Ordering system comes with a [QR code ordering system][33] where your customers
can scan these QR codes to access the restaurant menu on their phones without needing a mobile app
and order food directly from there and make the payment too.
* **No App Needed -** A simple but very effective way to order food from the table and pay at the
  same time. Your guest can simply scan the QR code from their mobile camera and order from there.
* **Eliminate Order Error -** Contactless table ordering not only increases safety for guest and
  staff but also improve efficiency by elimination wrong and incomplete orders.
* **Charge Payment - **Your guest can make a payment right from the mobile screen after they place
  an order or you can also enable the cash payment option.
* **Get Orders in ORA - **You will receive orders directly in your order receiving mobile app with
  payment confirmation.
* **QR Code -** The system allows you to generate unlimited QR codes directly from your admin panel
  in pdf format. Simply print and place on tables.

## Restaurant Loyalty Program

The Foodship reward point system helps restaurants to motivate their customers to use their in-house
online food ordering system. This feature provides a rewarding and [customized experience for
frequent customers][34]. Our loyalty program system provides the following controls to the
restaurant.
* **Reward Point Earning:** Restaurant can decide the minimum order amount customers need to spend
  to earn reward points.
* **Point Redemption:** Restaurants an specify how a customer can use his/her reward points and the
  maximum number of points that can be redeemed at once.
* **Bonus Point Incentives:** To encourage repeat visits, restaurants have the offer to provide
  bonus points to customers on their first order.

## GRAPHICA EXPO 2027

Περισσότερα από 35 χρόνια επιτυχημένης πορείας έχει συμπληρώσει στην Ελλάδα η **GRAPHICA EXPO**, η
μεγαλύτερη & μακροβιότερη Εμπορική Έκθεση Γραφικών Τεχνών & Οπτικής Επικοινωνίας. 

Από το 1991 η **GRAPHICA EXPO** επικοινωνεί και προβάλει τις τεχνολογικές εξελίξεις του κλάδου των
Εκτυπώσεων, της Επιγραφοποιίας, της Οπτικής Επικοινωνίας, της Χάρτινης Συσκευασίας και της Ετικέτας.

Επιχειρήσεις εμπορίας μηχανημάτων, αναλώσιμων και υπηρεσιών από όλο το φάσμα της Βιομηχανίας των
Γραφικών Τεχνών & της Οπτικής Επικοινωνίας επιλέγουν συστηματικά την έκθεση ώστε να παρουσιάσουν τις
νέες καινοτομίες τους, σε χιλιάδες επαγγελματίες επισκέπτες που προέρχονται τόσο από την Ελλάδα όσο
και από γείτονες χώρες.

Με σταθερή ανοδική πορεία την τελευταία δεκαετία, η** GRAPHICA EXPO** επιστρέφει δυναμικά στις
**19-21 Φεβρουαρίου 2027** στο Εκθεσιακό Κέντρο **MEDITERRANEAN EXHIBITION CENTER (M.E.C.)** στην
Παιανία Αττικής.

## Στατιστικά Επισκεψιμότητας

Με μεγάλη εμπορική επιτυχία πραγματοποιήθηκε για ακόμη μία χρονιά η 18η διοργάνωση της GRAPHICA
EXPO, το 2025.

Ο κλάδος των Εκτυπώσεων και της Οπτικής Επικοινωνίας έδωσε δυναμικά το «παρών» και τις τρεις ημέρες
της διοργάνωσης, γεμίζοντας τους διαδρόμους της έκθεσης με έντονο ενδιαφέρον για επενδύσεις σε νέους
εξοπλισμούς και υλικά τελευταίας τεχνολογίας.

Με περισσότερες από 7.000 επιχειρήσεις από όλη την Ελλάδα, την Κύπρο και όμορες βαλκανικές χώρες να
επισκέπτονται την έκθεση, η 18η διοργάνωση της GRAPHICA EXPO στέφθηκε με απόλυτη επιτυχία.

**7.000+ επιχειρήσεις επισκέφθηκαν την GRAPHICA EXPO 2025**
60% Εκτυπώσεις / Συσκευασία
35% Επιγραφοποιία / Οπτική Επικοινωνία
25% Δημιουργικά γραφεία / Διαφήμιση
6% Τελικοί πελάτες / Γενικό εμπόριο
**Τα ανωτέρω ποσοστά δεν αθροίζουν 100, καθώς οι επιχειρήσεις του κλάδου μας προσφέρουν ποικίλες
υπηρεσίες εκτυπώσεων και ως εκ τούτου εμπίπτουν σε περισσότερες από μία κατηγορίες.*

Η πλειονότητα των επισκεπτών ήταν ιδιοκτήτες επιχειρήσεων και στελέχη ή υπεύθυνοι επενδύσεων /
προμηθειών.

**55% των επισκεπτών από την περιφέρεια
**Για ακόμη μία φορά, ιδιαίτερα σημαντική ήταν η παρουσία επαγγελματιών από περιοχές εκτός Αττικής,
οι οποίοι ξεπέρασαν το 55% του συνόλου των επισκεπτών.

**+30% Νέοι Εκθέτες**
Παράλληλα, αυξήθηκαν σημαντικά – κατά περίπου 30% – οι επιχειρήσεις που επέλεξαν για πρώτη φορά τη
συμμετοχή τους στην έκθεση για την προβολή τους, δηλώνοντας υψηλό βαθμό ικανοποίησης από τα

## GRAPHICA EXPO 2027

Περισσότερα από 35 χρόνια επιτυχημένης πορείας έχει συμπληρώσει στην Ελλάδα η **GRAPHICA EXPO**, η
μεγαλύτερη & μακροβιότερη Εμπορική Έκθεση Γραφικών Τεχνών & Οπτικής Επικοινωνίας. 

Από το 1991 η **GRAPHICA EXPO** επικοινωνεί και προβάλει τις τεχνολογικές εξελίξεις του κλάδου των
Εκτυπώσεων, της Επιγραφοποιίας, της Οπτικής Επικοινωνίας, της Χάρτινης Συσκευασίας και της Ετικέτας.

Επιχειρήσεις εμπορίας μηχανημάτων, αναλώσιμων και υπηρεσιών από όλο το φάσμα της Βιομηχανίας των
Γραφικών Τεχνών & της Οπτικής Επικοινωνίας επιλέγουν συστηματικά την έκθεση ώστε να παρουσιάσουν τις
νέες καινοτομίες τους, σε χιλιάδες επαγγελματίες επισκέπτες που προέρχονται τόσο από την Ελλάδα όσο
και από γείτονες χώρες.

Με σταθερή ανοδική πορεία την τελευταία δεκαετία, η** GRAPHICA EXPO** επιστρέφει δυναμικά στις
**19-21 Φεβρουαρίου 2027** στο Εκθεσιακό Κέντρο **MEDITERRANEAN EXHIBITION CENTER (M.E.C.)** στην
Παιανία Αττικής.

# Manufacturing

Pressure Sensitive Labels Linerless Labels Direct Mail Blank Labels On-Demand Label Printers
[Adhesive label manufactured by Hub Labels for Uncle Jerry’s pretzel bags.]

## ADHESIVE LABELS

We specialize in custom pressure-sensitive labels with up to 12-color printing and wide web
capability. Our material options include coated paper, BOPP, PET, vinyl, and foil—ideal for
industries like food, beverage, personal care, and industrial packaging. Combined with a full range
of adhesives and finishes, our pressure-sensitive label solutions offer durability, standout shelf
appeal, and reliable performance on a wide variety of surfaces.

[ Pressure-Sensitive Labels ][21]
[Linerless label wrapped around a crab dip pretzel. Linerless labels are commonly used for cryovac
wrapped seafood products.]

## Linerless Labels

Our linerless labels use pattern coat adhesive to reduce waste and improve production efficiency.
Designed for tray-wrapped and vacuum-sealed packaging, they offer more labels per roll, faster
application, and fewer changeovers. Available in food-safe and freezer-grade materials, linerless
labels are a sustainable solution for high-speed labeling without sacrificing quality.

[ Linerless Labels ][22]
[Examples of direct mail label capabilities including welcome to Maryland stickers and blank labels
for purposes such as addresses or identifying products.]

## Direct Mail

We print high-quality direct mail labels that help boost response rates and increase donations. From
address labels and custom sticker sheets to piggyback labels, decals, and coupons, we deliver sharp,
consistent results. Our flexographic and hybrid digital presses are ideal for nonprofits, political
campaigns, and marketers managing multi-SKU mailing projects

[ Direct Mail Labels ][23]
[Forklift moving a large roll of blank labels. Blank labels are used for thermal transfer and
printing.]

## Blank Labels

We offer blank labels for thermal transfer and direct thermal printing, including linerless options.
Perfect for retail, logistics, manufacturing, and shipping, our blank labels ensure smooth
performance with popular printers and labeling systems.

[ Blank Labels ][24]
[Epson Colorworks label printer for resale.]

## On-Demand Label Printers

As an Epson ColorWorks Authorized Reseller, we offer full-color on-demand label printers that reduce
inventory and simplify SKU management. These high-speed printers produce durable, eye-catching
labels, ideal for short runs, variable data, and efficient workflows.

[ Label Printers ][25]
[ Let’s Work Together ][26]

[ Get a quote ][27]
Food labels need to do more than just look good. They have to handle cold, moisture, heat, and
constant handling. We build pressure sensitive and linerless food labels that last from the
production line to the store shelf. From produce to meat trays, we’ve got a solution that works.
[ Food Labels ][28]

## Beverage Labels

[ Get a quote ][29]
From craft brews to cold-pressed juices, beverage labels have to hold up—literally and visually.
Think condensation, friction, refrigeration, and still looking great on the shelf. At Hub, we don’t
just help you choose the right material and adhesive—we think through how your label will perform in
the real world. Because when your product is in someone’s hand, the label should feel as premium as
what’s inside.
[ Beverage Labels ][30]

## Health & Home

[ Get a quote ][31]
Labels for health and home products need to stay on and stay sharp. We print custom labels for
candles, vitamins, supplements, and personal care that hold up to moisture, oils, and daily use. If
you need a durable label that performs, while still looking great, we’re ready to help.
[ Home Product Labels ][32]

through with labels that look premium and perform even better.

## A label printer built
## for growing brands.

Since 2019 we've printed for over *800 brands* — from independent launches to household names on
supermarket shelves across the UK and Europe.

Lemur was founded on a simple idea: label printing should feel like a proper service, not a trade
transaction. Too many brands were stuck between commodity printers who couldn't embellish and
boutique suppliers who couldn't move fast. We built a printing business to sit in between — and
we've kept investing ever since. Today we run one of the most embellished digital-and-flexo set-ups
in the country: six presses and finishing lines (including two ABG Digicon 3's) under one roof, and
a team whose job is to hit your launch dates, not invent them.

# Product identification for your connected supply chain

# IT'S ALL RIGHT THERE ™

Loftware is how you can finally get product identification and supply chain collaboration right
across your entire ecosystem. With connected packaging and labels, you can save millions and reduce
risk – because the visibility and control you need is all right there.

[Contact us][77]

##### Eliminate supply chain blind spots

 

A single product identification error or regulatory mismatch can halt production, delay shipments,
or trigger costly recalls. Loftware Connect creates secure digital connections between sites,
suppliers, partners, customers, and product identification processes - ensuring every product moves
through your supply chain accurately and efficiently. With Loftware, it’s all right there. 

[Explore Loftware Connect][78]

## Be ready when the world moves, with Loftware Connect

## What if you could...

##### Manage the complexity

Get a highly configurable, enterprise-grade platform that ensures compliant, authentic, and
traceable products.

##### Make the connections

Get the only solution that creates an efficient, integrated supply chain for you, your suppliers,
and your partners. So everyone works from a shared, consistent product identity. 

##### Skip the worries

Get the reliability and scalability you need by partnering with the industry leader. 


## Say goodbye to costly unknowns

For far too long, companies like yours have had too many costly unknowns in their supply chain. With
so many variables and so much guesswork, there’s a greater chance of production delays, penalties,
recalls, and even reputational damage. Without supply chain collaboration across product identity,
these risks multiply across every handoff. 

 

Find out why more than 16,000 leading companies rely on Loftware to print over 75 billion labels
every year.

[Contact us][79]

It's all right there™

## See, manage, and control product identification

**Simplify labeling, packaging artwork, compliance, and collaboration across your entire supply
chain with Loftware’s industry-leading cloud-based solutions. **

Labeling

Centralize and standardize your labeling process in the cloud to design, manage, and print labels
with greater control and consistency. Ensure accuracy and compliance across global operations while
integrating seamlessly with your ERP, WMS, MES, and PLM systems. As your business grows, you can
scale effortlessly with a flexible, cloud‑based labeling solution.

[Learn more about Labeling with Loftware Cloud][80]
Artwork Management

Transform your packaging artwork process from concept to shelf with a streamlined, automated
workflow that eliminates delays. Real‑time collaboration keeps internal teams and external partners
aligned, while centralized content management ensures accuracy and consistency. You can also track
budgets, manage costs, and maintain compliance - all within a single, unified system.

[Discover Artwork Management with Smartflow][81]

# Nanometer‑class photonics positioning and direct optical fiber switching — designed for stability,
# low loss, and precision performance.

###### U Series Ultra Resolution
###### Nano Positioners

Luminos U Series Ultra Resolution Positioners integrate the Luminos designed ultra precise linear
stepping motor actuator to provide a highly stable, open loop, single layer system.

 

With industry leading 0.1um bi-directional backlash, and incremental move capability finer than
10nm, all without the need for Piezos, Luminos U Series Positioners far exceed SMF-28 waveguide
alignment requirements, allowing optimization within 0.01 dB without backlash compensation.

[LEARN MORE][48]

###### Photonics Integrated Circuit (PIC) Alignment

The Luminos Photonics Integrated Circuit (PIC) Alignment System provides a compact workstation
allowing up to four sided alignment for assembly of complex PIC devices.

[LEARN MORE][49]
[Luminos PIC Alignment System]
[U6S.jpg]

###### [CORALIGN™ ][50][Positioners][51]

Luminos CORALIGN™ Positioners are so resolute and stable that you can easily align singlemode fibers
with your hand on the micrometer and they will hold alignment for weeks.


They are the only positioners in the world to use Ratio Drive™ with standard micrometers, achieving
a mechanical backlash that is 10X less than the limits of operator sensitivity.

[LEARN MORE][52]
[I6000 Front Angle View.png]

###### [CORALIGN™ Switches][53]

Luminos CORALIGN™ fiber optic switches incorporate a patented moving fiber design to achieve direct
fiber to fiber coupling through either an air or oil filled gap, achieving the lowest Insertion
losses in the industry. Losses as low as 0.01 dB (MM) and 0.2 dB (SM) that are only possible with
direct fiber-to-fiber coupling. 

[Generic Switch.png]
[LEARN MORE][54]
OEM

###### OEM Integration
######  

Luminos precision nano-positioning and moving-fiber optical switching technologies are widely
integrated into leading-edge solutions across the photonics industry, including advanced photonics
and PIC alignment systems, quantum computing research platforms, and precision optical
instrumentation. OEM configurations are available for custom system integration, specialized
interfaces, and customized packaging, including private-label solutions. Contact us to discuss how
Luminos Photonics technology can be integrated as an OEM component within your application.

You deserve a partner who makes it easy to meet your goals. Good news—you just found one. At Meyers,
we’re dedicated to creating a sustainable future for people, products, and our planet. We believe
that great packaging is a powerful, yet humble tool that enhances our daily lives, introduces us to
our favorite new foods, and inspires unforgettable adventures.

We make that happen by creating sustainable packaging, and labels. And it takes a special group to
deliver such a tall order. Our team is a collection of hard-working, caring problem solvers who
enable innovative brand leaders. Join us, great things lie ahead!

From high-impact folding cartons to cutting-edge RFID, our solutions are
engineered for results.

# Custom Label Manufacturing
# QR Codes • Variable Data • Sticker Sheets

Welcome to Midwest Label Supply! We are a custom digital printer and convertor of labels with
software automation in our DNA. Our sweet spot is custom [variable data printing][34] of
individualized [serialized QR code labels][35], [Data Matrix codes][36], 2D barcodes and other smart
labels. Whether you need serialized QR labels for product authentication or an [API-connected direct
mail printer][37] that triggers from your CRM, we handle it. Midwest Label Supply prints
high-quality, custom, [pressure-sensitive labels][38] for a variety of technical applications.

## Serialized QR Code Labels & Variable Data Printing

Our specialty in [serialized QR code labels][39] and [variable data printing][40] enables unique
serialization for product tracking and customer engagement. Each serialized QR label gets its own
unique code, so you can track individual items from production line to end consumer. Our [variable
data label printer technology][41] provides cutting-edge solutions for modern businesses. Recent
enhancements in [QR Code Labels][42], [Data Matrix Labels][43], NFC Chips and RFID tags provide
opportunities for advances in tracking, individualization and serialization of products and
processes. We work with CPG companies to manufacture beautiful labels while eliminating supply chain
difficulties through product lifecycle tracking. Our digital printing process enables small runs
with variable content information (text, images, codes, UIDs) for enhanced customer experiences.

## Custom Sticker Sheets & On-Demand Fulfillment

Our [on-demand digital printing][44], die cutting and custom sticker sheet production, paired with
packaging services allows us to provide direct fulfillment to customers across the US. From single
custom sticker sheets to large format [variable data label sheets][45], we handle everything from
design to delivery. Need to trigger print jobs programmatically? Our direct mail API printer
capabilities let you send orders straight from your ecommerce platform or CRM. We also help [foreign
companies save money on direct mail][46] by sending from within the US to avoid international post
restrictions and tariffs.

## Popular Label Solutions

#### [Short Run Labels][47]

NO minimum orders! Perfect for startups and small batches with fast turnaround.

#### [Pressure Sensitive Labels][48]

Self-adhesive labels in 50+ materials for automated and hand application.

#### [Custom Die Cutting][49]

Precision cutting for unique shapes and specialized applications.

#### [Milwaukee Label Printing][50]

Local Milwaukee service with same-day pickup available.

#### [Chicago Label Printing][51]

Next-day delivery to Chicagoland area businesses.

#### [Direct Mail API][52]

REST API, signed webhooks, and USPS Informed Visibility tracking. A Lob, PostGrid, and Postalytics
alternative.

## **Custom Printed** Label Types

### [Digital and
### Flexographic Labels][51]

Whether your project lends itself more so to digital labels or flexographic labels (based off
factors such as run size), both of these two pressure sensitive label solutions create a very
similar “sticker-like” result which can be attached to most shapes and surfaces with ease.

### [Roll Fed
### Wrap Labels][52]

Custom roll fed wrap labels are just as they sound- a label solution that wraps completely around a
product to offer 360-degree coverage. Due to the nature of these labels, they are found almost
exclusively on mostly-cylindrical containers such as bottles, cans, and tubes.

### [Shrink Sleeve
### Labels][53]

Regardless of your intended application of shrink (whether it be full shrink sleeve packaging,
multi-pack shrink bands, or preform neck shrink bands), all shrink products feature a 360-degree
label sleeve (or band) which is heated and shrunk to conform to the unique shape of your container.

### [Smart Labeling
### and Tags][54]

Smart Labels—Radio Frequency Identification (abbr. RFID) and Near Field Communication (abbr.
NFC)—are the future of asset tracking, inventory management, and even interactive marketing. In very
simplified terms, think of RFID and NFC as the new and improved alternatives to barcoding AND QR
codes.

Over half a century ago, we created the custom label company that was known as National Printing
Converters (NPC), this was in an era before the invention of digital, laser printers, and thermal
labels! Now that new technologies and opportunities exist we have updated our brand name to reflect
exactly what we produce. So although, the official business name NPC remains unchanged, our current
website and branding echoes the very essence of our operations: National Custom Labels.

Since those formative years, National has single-mindedly honed our focus on one principal area: the
[creation of custom labels][20] designed to address the distinctive needs of our unique clientele.
We understand that you may encounter clients whose label requirements surpass the capabilities of
generic, stock labels. Possibly, such businesses might have been declined in the past due to the
complexity of their needs?

Today, National Custom Labels presents you with an unparalleled opportunity. Not only can you
generate additional revenue from these challenging orders, but you can also diversify your client
base and stimulate the growth of your business. Partnering with National could open up new horizons
for your venture and contribute to its sustained success.

We offer a wide range of custom labels and tags available in a variety of sizes and shapes. Custom
labels available in an endless combination of adhesives and face stocks. Our custom labels and tags
process on all major print technologies. Custom labels on a roll, sheet, or piece.  Thermal Transfer
Ribbons are available, as well! If you have a custom label need, we can fulfill it.

## Why Work With National Custom Labels?

****
**Scientific process with professional collaboration!**
We work with you to define your exact requirements then get to work using our process developed over
50 years to create the custom label you were looking for.

**Plain ID Products!**
If you desire we will stay completely invisible to your clients with absolutely brand free
communications and delivery of your custom label products.

**Clear Communications**
You’ll have a dedicated product manager and you can connect with our support team online or good old
fashion phone any time you wish to discuss your label project.

**Fast Shipping and Delivery**
Centrally located in Indiana, once your order is complete it will be shipped immediately. Want to
know the status of your order? Connect with us via chat or call us for the latest status.

* CUSTOM SIZES UP TO 18″ WIDE BY 24″ LONG
* UP TO 6 COLORS, INCLUDING 4-COLOR PROCESS
* CUSTOM ADHESIVE AND SILICONE COATING
* LABEL/FORM COMBINATIONS
* LINERLESS LABELS

* THERMAL TRANSFER

* TYPEWRITER / HANDWRITTEN

* PADDING

picking by reducing walk time by 50% and increasing operator pick rates by 50-100%. Numina's latest
generation 3,300 lbs. capacity AMRs can pick up to 30 orders per mission, boosting productivity to
**the industry's highest hourly AMR pick rates.**

[Learn about high performance AMR order picking][172]
2. Robotic GTP

Robotic GTP optimizes product storage, retrieval, and order picking. Voice and pick-to-light order
consolidation walls at the GTP workstations batch pick 32 orders at a time, increasing picks per
tote visit and achieving over 300 line picks per hour for higher productivity. Our conveyor-based
pack automation technologies combine pick and pack to carton processes with in-line scan-weight
vision content audit, automatic and semi-automatic documentation print & insert, taper-sealers,
scan-label-auto-manifest, SLAM, and shipping sortation for end-to-end GTP pick, pack, and ship order
fulfillment automation.

## The best free DYMO alternative

Tired of DYMO Connect crashing? You're not alone.

DYMO Connect is the official software for DYMO LabelWriter printers — and it's universally disliked.
It's slow, crashes frequently, requires a bulky download, and only works with DYMO printers. Since
the LabelWriter 550 series, DYMO has even added DRM to their label rolls, forcing you to buy only
DYMO-branded labels at premium prices.

entirely in your browser — no download, no installation, no updates to manage. It works with all
DYMO label sizes (99010, 99012, 99014, 11354, and more), and it exports PDF files at the exact
dimensions your DYMO LabelWriter expects.

What is Print-File.com and how does it work?

Print-File.com is a free online document printing tool that allows you to upload and print various
file types directly from your web browser without installing any software. Simply drag and drop or
select your file (PDF, Word document, image, or text file), preview it in your browser, and click

* **PDF files** (.pdf) - Full support for standard PDF documents

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

## Got Questions about Music Distribution? 

### Which streaming platforms do you distribute to?

+

Our digital music distribution service distributes to all the major streaming services: Spotify,
Apple Music, TikTok, YouTube, Deezer, Tidal and 200+ other streaming platforms and stores globally.

### What makes this platform different from other music distribution platforms?

+

We offer free accounts to verified artists who what proven industry traction. This is a strict
application process though our A&R team who review every single applicant.

Why do we do this? 
- We are actively combating streaming fraud in the the music industry
- To ensure that no bad actors get access to our system and take advantage of the tools we offer
- To promote good practices within the music industry
- We want to be proud of all of the music that we distribute and work on at Unchained Music.  

### How do I transfer my catalog from another music distributor?

+

Transferring your catalog from another music distribution service is simple. Before you start,
you’ll need a few key pieces of information, including:
‍

• The UPC and ISRC (these help DSPs identify your existing release);
• Release title and track title(s);Artist(s) name(s);
• The Original Release date and;
• The exact same audio and cover art files from the previous release.

This is the same process for almost every digital music distribution company.

### Are there any fees and do I keep all my royalties?

+

For immediate access to the platform there is a base subscription fee. Artists and labels keep all
there royalties.

For a highly select group of artists we offer free use of our platform, but this at the discretion
of the A&R team. Artists and labels under this core plan also keep 100% of their royalties.

Our unchained partners are all subject to custom deals for our artist and label services.

### Do you offer playlisting or marketing support?

+

Yes - we offer full artists and label services to a select artists. You can find out more [here][68]

# HERMA – the brand for labels, labelers & self-adhesive material

## HERMA develops and manufactures self-adhesive materials, labels, and labeling machines for
## packaging and product identification—a globally unique, integrated chain of expertise. HERMA also
## offers solutions for automated product handling and consumer products for school, office, and
## home use.

[More about the company][26]

## For labeling with added value

HERMA is a **leading European innovator** in the development and manufacture of sustainable
**adhesive materials**, a sought-after specialist in efficient **labeling solutions**, and a
technology leader in **labelers** and **labeling machines**. Founded in 1906, HERMA remains
family-owned and, with five foreign subsidiaries, is focused on long-term, internationally
successful corporate development.

### Self-adhesive Material

HERMA's "Self-adhesive Material" division offers label materials ([papers ][51]and [films][52]),
[adhesives ][53]and [release liners][54] combined to form [adhesive materials][55] for a wide range
of industries. With these numerous self-adhesive materials, labels can be produced for a wide
variety of labeling applications.

[HERMA Self-adhesive Material][56]

### Labels for office and home

In addition to labels for office, retail and logistics, the HERMA "Office & Home" area also offers a
wide range of craft and school supplies. [Folders][57], [book covers][58], [stickers ][59]as well as
our [mounting][60] and [archiving][61] systems (photo) can be used at home as well as in the office
or [school][62]. Our labels can also be used in a variety of ways, e.g.:
* In the office as [file labels][63]
* As an [address label][64] for sending letters and parcels
* Seal and security labels
* Pre-printed labels for usage as signs, also in outdoor environment

With HERMA labels for office and home, you are equipped for every application.

Design your labels - simply professional. With our free software [Label Assistant Online][65] or our

and inkjet printers.

## Ведущий производитель термопринтеров AIYIN

Компания AIYIN была основана в 2015 году и находится в городе Сямынь, Китай. Мы производим первый
в Китае принтер этикеток профессионального класса.

Ориентируясь на потребности пользователей, мы занимаемся исследованиями и разработкой принтеров
для печати этикеток, термотрансферных принтеров, принтеров для печати чеков, принтеров для дома
и офиса, сканирующих терминалов, а также программного обеспечения для печати и облачных сервисов,
предоставляя безопасные и надёжные продукты и профессиональные решения для полнопроцессной печати.

Компания имеет штаб-квартиры в Сямэне и Шанхае, а также центры продаж и обслуживания по всему миру.

* **Квалифицированный персонал — 600+ человек**

**DuraMark Technologies. Turning labels into real business solutions**

**DuraMark Technologies is not your ordinary label maker, and for a number of important**

**reasons. We do more than provide stickers, we deliver real business solutions that impact**

**everything from overhead and inventory costs to LEAN manufacturing to delivery schedules. **

 

**Because we know the impact our labels can have, we’re constantly innovating to deliver**

**smarter solutions and bigger ideas.**

**Watch and learn what sets DuraMark Technologies labels apart.**

**Durable, high-quality labels.**

Because our focus is on creating labels and decals for manufacturing and outdoor equipment,
durability, clarity, and adhesion are always top of mind. DuraMark’s proprietary, premium material
sandwich means superior fade resistance. Our labels stand the test of time, maintaining their
integrity for more than 10 years.

[ See what's behind a DuraMark label ][34]

**A faster, more flexible approach to**

** label production.**

DuraMark takes a 100% digital approach when it comes to printing. This creates crystal clear labels
and decals that go from art to finished part in minutes. Because we’re digital, we can respond
quickly to changes, whether it’s a new brand or a new ANSI requirement. And there are no minimums,
which is ideal for prototypes and smaller changes.

[ Find out more about the benefits of digital printing ][35]

 

***"DuraMark label kits have helped eliminate errors on our assembly floor."***

 

**- Haulotte / BilJax, Operations**

 

**Product-specific label kits reduce**

** inventory, mistakes, and delays.**

If you think of kitting as multiple label sheets stuck in a bag that creates confusion on the
production floor, you haven’t experienced DuraMark kitting. Our approach is streamlined, exacting,
and proven to reduce time and money.

[ Discover what sets DuraMark kitting apart ][36]

**Variable data printing. Greater ****flexibility, speed, and affordability.**

Many manufacturers require labels with specific, unique information like serial numbers, VIN
numbers, and asset numbers. These labels are critical to your operation and require variable
printing, in which elements are changed from one printed piece to the next. DuraMark’s innovation

and digital technology takes variable data to the next level.

[ Explore DuraMark's approach to variable data ][37]

# Australia's Best Online Food Ordering System & Takeaway Software for Restaurants

Foodship is a commission-free **online food ordering system for restaurants & cafes based out of
Australia**. A reservation management system made for your restaurant, an alternative to Menulog,
UberEats & DoorDash. A complete blend of every tool you need to operate your restaurant, or takeaway
joint successfully.

[][25]
[Website][26]

Free website & web hosting

[][27]
[Payment Options][28]

Multiple Payment Gateways

[][29]
[ORA][30]

App for Restaurant Staff

## Online Ordering Menu System

In Australia, many restaurant business use online food ordering system. Aren’t you? Foodship’s
Online Food Ordering System provides multiple ways to create & showcase your menu.
* **Simple Menu –** Menu for standalone food items with a simple add to cart button
* **Advanced –** For food items where customization is required for Eg Pizza or create your salad,
  sushi, etc. multiple levels with separate rules for each level for example – Force customer to
  select a certain number of food items or keep it optional or select a set minimum.
* **Half & Half Pizza –** For Pizza Ordering System, required by pizza stores generally where you
  allow your customer to choose 2 different kinds of pizza and make one, for example, half veg and
  half meat.
* **Combos –** Option to create combos by clubbing items together and sell for a special price. For
  example, select 3 items from 5 options for a discounted price.
* **Custom Availability– ** Sell a food item on a specific day of the week or at a specific time.
  Set a special price for a certain day.
[Online Table Reservation][Online Table Reservation]

## Online Table Reservation System

Foodship **Online Food Ordering System** also comes with a table reservation management system that
enables your customers to book a table online in your restaurant. Foodship Online Food Ordering
Platform connects the table reservation management system to your existing website of Australia also
available integrated with our free websites.

Foodship’s table reservation system can be connected to Google’s proprietary Book a Table button.
Restaurant’s customer sees this Book A Table button on a google search result and can directly land
to your table reservation system.  

Accept or Decline table reservation request in one click and manage from the admin panel or mobile
app. Send table reservation confirmation to the customer via email and SMS. 

[Foodship - Restaurant Gift Voucher System][Foodship - Restaurant Gift Voucher System]

## Restaurant Gift Card System

A proven method to [boost revenue][31] and increase cash flow for your business. Foodship’s
Restaurant Gift Card System allows you to create, sell, redeem, and manage gift cards. Customers can
buy gift cards from your food ordering website, gift them to friends and family and use it to buy
food online or dine-in customers. These Gift Cards can be redeemed on the Foodship [Restaurant POS
system][32] as well.
* **Retail Gift Card -** Create seasonal gift cards with custom amounts and look and feel. For eg a
  $50 value gift card and sell it for $ 45 on your website. Set expiry date, allow to use with
  online food orders , and dine in.
* **Complimentary Gift Card -** A proven way to retain unhappy customers. Use it to oblige unhappy
  customers or can be used as a method to refund some amount to the customer.
* **Redeem - **Customers can use the gift card for online food ordering, and you can also charge
  gift cards via the restaurant staff mobile app for Dine-In customers.
* **Manage -** Detailed reporting is available on the admin dashboard for Gift Card buyers and
  Redeemers.

## GRAPHICA EXPO 2027

Περισσότερα από 35 χρόνια επιτυχημένης πορείας έχει συμπληρώσει στην Ελλάδα η **GRAPHICA EXPO**, η
μεγαλύτερη & μακροβιότερη Εμπορική Έκθεση Γραφικών Τεχνών & Οπτικής Επικοινωνίας. 

Από το 1991 η **GRAPHICA EXPO** επικοινωνεί και προβάλει τις τεχνολογικές εξελίξεις του κλάδου των
Εκτυπώσεων, της Επιγραφοποιίας, της Οπτικής Επικοινωνίας, της Χάρτινης Συσκευασίας και της Ετικέτας.

Επιχειρήσεις εμπορίας μηχανημάτων, αναλώσιμων και υπηρεσιών από όλο το φάσμα της Βιομηχανίας των
Γραφικών Τεχνών & της Οπτικής Επικοινωνίας επιλέγουν συστηματικά την έκθεση ώστε να παρουσιάσουν τις
νέες καινοτομίες τους, σε χιλιάδες επαγγελματίες επισκέπτες που προέρχονται τόσο από την Ελλάδα όσο
και από γείτονες χώρες.

Με σταθερή ανοδική πορεία την τελευταία δεκαετία, η** GRAPHICA EXPO** επιστρέφει δυναμικά στις
**19-21 Φεβρουαρίου 2027** στο Εκθεσιακό Κέντρο **MEDITERRANEAN EXHIBITION CENTER (M.E.C.)** στην
Παιανία Αττικής.

## Στατιστικά Επισκεψιμότητας

Με μεγάλη εμπορική επιτυχία πραγματοποιήθηκε για ακόμη μία χρονιά η 18η διοργάνωση της GRAPHICA
EXPO, το 2025.

Ο κλάδος των Εκτυπώσεων και της Οπτικής Επικοινωνίας έδωσε δυναμικά το «παρών» και τις τρεις ημέρες
της διοργάνωσης, γεμίζοντας τους διαδρόμους της έκθεσης με έντονο ενδιαφέρον για επενδύσεις σε νέους
εξοπλισμούς και υλικά τελευταίας τεχνολογίας.

Με περισσότερες από 7.000 επιχειρήσεις από όλη την Ελλάδα, την Κύπρο και όμορες βαλκανικές χώρες να
επισκέπτονται την έκθεση, η 18η διοργάνωση της GRAPHICA EXPO στέφθηκε με απόλυτη επιτυχία.

**7.000+ επιχειρήσεις επισκέφθηκαν την GRAPHICA EXPO 2025**
60% Εκτυπώσεις / Συσκευασία
35% Επιγραφοποιία / Οπτική Επικοινωνία
25% Δημιουργικά γραφεία / Διαφήμιση
6% Τελικοί πελάτες / Γενικό εμπόριο
**Τα ανωτέρω ποσοστά δεν αθροίζουν 100, καθώς οι επιχειρήσεις του κλάδου μας προσφέρουν ποικίλες
υπηρεσίες εκτυπώσεων και ως εκ τούτου εμπίπτουν σε περισσότερες από μία κατηγορίες.*

Η πλειονότητα των επισκεπτών ήταν ιδιοκτήτες επιχειρήσεων και στελέχη ή υπεύθυνοι επενδύσεων /
προμηθειών.

**55% των επισκεπτών από την περιφέρεια
**Για ακόμη μία φορά, ιδιαίτερα σημαντική ήταν η παρουσία επαγγελματιών από περιοχές εκτός Αττικής,
οι οποίοι ξεπέρασαν το 55% του συνόλου των επισκεπτών.

**+30% Νέοι Εκθέτες**
Παράλληλα, αυξήθηκαν σημαντικά – κατά περίπου 30% – οι επιχειρήσεις που επέλεξαν για πρώτη φορά τη
συμμετοχή τους στην έκθεση για την προβολή τους, δηλώνοντας υψηλό βαθμό ικανοποίησης από τα
αποτελέσματα της συμμετοχής τους.

***Όλο και περισσότερες επιχειρήσεις επιλέγουν τη GRAPHICA EXPO ως βασικό σημείο παρουσίασης νέων
τεχνολογιών και λύσεων στην ελληνική αγορά των Γραφικών Τεχνών και της Οπτικής Επικοινωνίας.***

## ADHESIVE LABELS

We specialize in custom pressure-sensitive labels with up to 12-color printing and wide web
capability. Our material options include coated paper, BOPP, PET, vinyl, and foil—ideal for
industries like food, beverage, personal care, and industrial packaging. Combined with a full range
of adhesives and finishes, our pressure-sensitive label solutions offer durability, standout shelf
appeal, and reliable performance on a wide variety of surfaces.

[ Pressure-Sensitive Labels ][21]
[Linerless label wrapped around a crab dip pretzel. Linerless labels are commonly used for cryovac
wrapped seafood products.]

## Linerless Labels

Our linerless labels use pattern coat adhesive to reduce waste and improve production efficiency.
Designed for tray-wrapped and vacuum-sealed packaging, they offer more labels per roll, faster
application, and fewer changeovers. Available in food-safe and freezer-grade materials, linerless
labels are a sustainable solution for high-speed labeling without sacrificing quality.

[ Linerless Labels ][22]
[Examples of direct mail label capabilities including welcome to Maryland stickers and blank labels
for purposes such as addresses or identifying products.]

## Direct Mail

We print high-quality direct mail labels that help boost response rates and increase donations. From
address labels and custom sticker sheets to piggyback labels, decals, and coupons, we deliver sharp,
consistent results. Our flexographic and hybrid digital presses are ideal for nonprofits, political
campaigns, and marketers managing multi-SKU mailing projects

labels are a sustainable solution for high-speed labeling without sacrificing quality.

## Meet Label Specialties, a trade-only printer.

Since 1976, Label Specialties has produced labels for distributors around the globe. Proud to be
located in Louisville, Kentucky, Label Specialties is a full-service label printing and
manufacturing company with a 22,000 square-foot facility and 10,000 feet of warehouse space. We
produce creative, attractive, and affordable solutions to help our distributors look like heroes to
their clients. We’ll provide fast, wholesale quotes and quick turnaround–even for next day labels
and stickers!

#### Experience in every label. We’re the label experts.

We understand every facet of the printing industry. Label Specialties is a privately held company.
The owners run the day-to-day printing operation, and many of our employees have been with us for
more than 20 years. Their collective expertise goes into every label we produce.

## A label printer built
## for growing brands.

Since 2019 we've printed for over *800 brands* — from independent launches to household names on
supermarket shelves across the UK and Europe.

Lemur was founded on a simple idea: label printing should feel like a proper service, not a trade
transaction. Too many brands were stuck between commodity printers who couldn't embellish and
boutique suppliers who couldn't move fast. We built a printing business to sit in between — and
we've kept investing ever since. Today we run one of the most embellished digital-and-flexo set-ups
in the country: six presses and finishing lines (including two ABG Digicon 3's) under one roof, and
a team whose job is to hit your launch dates, not invent them.

# Product identification for your connected supply chain

# IT'S ALL RIGHT THERE ™

Loftware is how you can finally get product identification and supply chain collaboration right
across your entire ecosystem. With connected packaging and labels, you can save millions and reduce
risk – because the visibility and control you need is all right there.

[Contact us][77]

##### Eliminate supply chain blind spots

 

A single product identification error or regulatory mismatch can halt production, delay shipments,
or trigger costly recalls. Loftware Connect creates secure digital connections between sites,
suppliers, partners, customers, and product identification processes - ensuring every product moves
through your supply chain accurately and efficiently. With Loftware, it’s all right there. 

[Explore Loftware Connect][78]

## Be ready when the world moves, with Loftware Connect

## What if you could...

##### Manage the complexity

Get a highly configurable, enterprise-grade platform that ensures compliant, authentic, and
traceable products.

##### Make the connections

Get the only solution that creates an efficient, integrated supply chain for you, your suppliers,
and your partners. So everyone works from a shared, consistent product identity. 

##### Skip the worries

Get the reliability and scalability you need by partnering with the industry leader. 


## Say goodbye to costly unknowns

For far too long, companies like yours have had too many costly unknowns in their supply chain. With
so many variables and so much guesswork, there’s a greater chance of production delays, penalties,
recalls, and even reputational damage. Without supply chain collaboration across product identity,
these risks multiply across every handoff. 

 

Find out why more than 16,000 leading companies rely on Loftware to print over 75 billion labels
every year.

[Contact us][79]

It's all right there™

## See, manage, and control product identification

**Simplify labeling, packaging artwork, compliance, and collaboration across your entire supply
chain with Loftware’s industry-leading cloud-based solutions. **

Labeling

Centralize and standardize your labeling process in the cloud to design, manage, and print labels
with greater control and consistency. Ensure accuracy and compliance across global operations while
integrating seamlessly with your ERP, WMS, MES, and PLM systems. As your business grows, you can
scale effortlessly with a flexible, cloud‑based labeling solution.

[Learn more about Labeling with Loftware Cloud][80]
Artwork Management

Transform your packaging artwork process from concept to shelf with a streamlined, automated
workflow that eliminates delays. Real‑time collaboration keeps internal teams and external partners
aligned, while centralized content management ensures accuracy and consistency. You can also track
budgets, manage costs, and maintain compliance - all within a single, unified system.

[Discover Artwork Management with Smartflow][81]

# Custom Label Manufacturing
# QR Codes • Variable Data • Sticker Sheets

Welcome to Midwest Label Supply! We are a custom digital printer and convertor of labels with
software automation in our DNA. Our sweet spot is custom [variable data printing][34] of
individualized [serialized QR code labels][35], [Data Matrix codes][36], 2D barcodes and other smart
labels. Whether you need serialized QR labels for product authentication or an [API-connected direct
mail printer][37] that triggers from your CRM, we handle it. Midwest Label Supply prints
high-quality, custom, [pressure-sensitive labels][38] for a variety of technical applications.

## Serialized QR Code Labels & Variable Data Printing

Our specialty in [serialized QR code labels][39] and [variable data printing][40] enables unique
serialization for product tracking and customer engagement. Each serialized QR label gets its own
unique code, so you can track individual items from production line to end consumer. Our [variable
data label printer technology][41] provides cutting-edge solutions for modern businesses. Recent
enhancements in [QR Code Labels][42], [Data Matrix Labels][43], NFC Chips and RFID tags provide
opportunities for advances in tracking, individualization and serialization of products and
processes. We work with CPG companies to manufacture beautiful labels while eliminating supply chain
difficulties through product lifecycle tracking. Our digital printing process enables small runs
with variable content information (text, images, codes, UIDs) for enhanced customer experiences.

## Custom Sticker Sheets & On-Demand Fulfillment

Our [on-demand digital printing][44], die cutting and custom sticker sheet production, paired with
packaging services allows us to provide direct fulfillment to customers across the US. From single
custom sticker sheets to large format [variable data label sheets][45], we handle everything from
design to delivery. Need to trigger print jobs programmatically? Our direct mail API printer
capabilities let you send orders straight from your ecommerce platform or CRM. We also help [foreign
companies save money on direct mail][46] by sending from within the US to avoid international post
restrictions and tariffs.

# Custom Label Manufacturing
# QR Codes • Variable Data • Sticker Sheets

Welcome to Midwest Label Supply! We are a custom digital printer and convertor of labels with
software automation in our DNA. Our sweet spot is custom [variable data printing][34] of
individualized [serialized QR code labels][35], [Data Matrix codes][36], 2D barcodes and other smart
labels. Whether you need serialized QR labels for product authentication or an [API-connected direct
mail printer][37] that triggers from your CRM, we handle it. Midwest Label Supply prints
high-quality, custom, [pressure-sensitive labels][38] for a variety of technical applications.

## Serialized QR Code Labels & Variable Data Printing

Our specialty in [serialized QR code labels][39] and [variable data printing][40] enables unique
serialization for product tracking and customer engagement. Each serialized QR label gets its own
unique code, so you can track individual items from production line to end consumer. Our [variable
data label printer technology][41] provides cutting-edge solutions for modern businesses. Recent
enhancements in [QR Code Labels][42], [Data Matrix Labels][43], NFC Chips and RFID tags provide
opportunities for advances in tracking, individualization and serialization of products and
processes. We work with CPG companies to manufacture beautiful labels while eliminating supply chain
difficulties through product lifecycle tracking. Our digital printing process enables small runs
with variable content information (text, images, codes, UIDs) for enhanced customer experiences.

## Custom Sticker Sheets & On-Demand Fulfillment

Our [on-demand digital printing][44], die cutting and custom sticker sheet production, paired with
packaging services allows us to provide direct fulfillment to customers across the US. From single
custom sticker sheets to large format [variable data label sheets][45], we handle everything from
design to delivery. Need to trigger print jobs programmatically? Our direct mail API printer
capabilities let you send orders straight from your ecommerce platform or CRM. We also help [foreign
companies save money on direct mail][46] by sending from within the US to avoid international post
restrictions and tariffs.

## Popular Label Solutions

#### [Short Run Labels][47]

NO minimum orders! Perfect for startups and small batches with fast turnaround.

#### [Pressure Sensitive Labels][48]

Self-adhesive labels in 50+ materials for automated and hand application.

#### [Custom Die Cutting][49]

Precision cutting for unique shapes and specialized applications.

#### [Milwaukee Label Printing][50]

Local Milwaukee service with same-day pickup available.

#### [Chicago Label Printing][51]

Next-day delivery to Chicagoland area businesses.

#### [Direct Mail API][52]

REST API, signed webhooks, and USPS Informed Visibility tracking. A Lob, PostGrid, and Postalytics
alternative.

## **Custom Printed** Label Types

### [Digital and
### Flexographic Labels][51]

Whether your project lends itself more so to digital labels or flexographic labels (based off
factors such as run size), both of these two pressure sensitive label solutions create a very
similar “sticker-like” result which can be attached to most shapes and surfaces with ease.

### [Roll Fed
### Wrap Labels][52]

Custom roll fed wrap labels are just as they sound- a label solution that wraps completely around a
product to offer 360-degree coverage. Due to the nature of these labels, they are found almost
exclusively on mostly-cylindrical containers such as bottles, cans, and tubes.

### [Shrink Sleeve
### Labels][53]

Regardless of your intended application of shrink (whether it be full shrink sleeve packaging,
multi-pack shrink bands, or preform neck shrink bands), all shrink products feature a 360-degree
label sleeve (or band) which is heated and shrunk to conform to the unique shape of your container.

### [Smart Labeling
### and Tags][54]

Smart Labels—Radio Frequency Identification (abbr. RFID) and Near Field Communication (abbr.
NFC)—are the future of asset tracking, inventory management, and even interactive marketing. In very
simplified terms, think of RFID and NFC as the new and improved alternatives to barcoding AND QR
codes.

## [**Label Equipment**
## and Supplies][55]

MPI Labels is an industry leader when it comes to all things “labels” so it should come as no
surprise that we have an entire department dedicated to helping your business determine the right
labeling equipment for your needs. Whether you’re utilizing us for your label production or not, we
are here to help you determine what labeling systems and equipment your business should be
implementing.  Our labeling systems and equipment include label applicators, print and apply
systems, RFID labeling equipment, heat shrink sleeve applicators, heat tunnels, steam tunnels, steam
generators, and standard and custom made systems, stands, and accessories.

We can source the largest collection of equipment replacement parts and printer consumables- such as
ink, drums, ribbon, software, and more. Whatever labeling device, MPI Labels can supply you all the
supplies, parts, and support to continue printing uninterrupted.

fulfillment automation.

## The best free DYMO alternative

Tired of DYMO Connect crashing? You're not alone.

DYMO Connect is the official software for DYMO LabelWriter printers — and it's universally disliked.
It's slow, crashes frequently, requires a bulky download, and only works with DYMO printers. Since
the LabelWriter 550 series, DYMO has even added DRM to their label rolls, forcing you to buy only
DYMO-branded labels at premium prices.

entirely in your browser — no download, no installation, no updates to manage. It works with all
DYMO label sizes (99010, 99012, 99014, 11354, and more), and it exports PDF files at the exact
dimensions your DYMO LabelWriter expects.
