What is Print-File.com and how does it work?

Print-File.com is a free online document printing tool that allows you to upload and print various
file types directly from your web browser without installing any software. Simply drag and drop or
select your file (PDF, Word document, image, or text file), preview it in your browser, and click
the print button to send it to your connected printer.

The entire process happens in your browser using client-side JavaScript, which means your files are
processed locally on your device for maximum privacy and security. No files are uploaded to external
servers.

What file formats are supported?

Print-File.com supports a wide range of common document and image formats:
* **PDF files** (.pdf) - Full support for standard PDF documents
* **Word documents** (.docx, .doc) - Microsoft Word files
* **Images** (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif) - Common image formats
* **Text files** (.txt) - Plain text documents

All formats are rendered accurately in the preview before printing, so you can verify the output
looks correct.

Is there a file size limit?

Yes, Print-File.com supports files up to **50MB in size**. This limit is in place to ensure optimal
performance and quick processing times in your browser.

Most standard documents are well under this limit. For reference, a typical PDF document is 1-5MB, a
Word document is 500KB-2MB, and images are usually 500KB-5MB. If you need to print a larger file,
consider splitting it into smaller parts or compressing it first.

Is my data safe and private?

**Absolutely.** Your privacy is our top priority. Print-File.com processes all files entirely in
your browser using JavaScript. This means:
* Your files **never leave your device**
* No files are uploaded to any server
* No data is stored or tracked
* Everything happens locally on your computer

Once you close the browser tab or refresh the page, the file is immediately cleared from memory. We
cannot access your files because they never reach our servers.

Do I need to install any software?

No installation required! Print-File.com is a completely web-based tool that runs directly in your
browser. There's no need to download, install, or update any software.

Simply visit the website, upload your file, and print. This works seamlessly on both macOS and
Windows without any platform-specific installations.

This makes it perfect for:
* Public computers or shared workstations
* Devices where you can't install software
* Quick one-time printing needs
* Mac users who don't want to install Adobe Reader or other PDF software
* Windows users looking for a lightweight alternative to heavy document readers
* Users who prefer not to clutter their system with additional programs

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes! Print-File.com is fully responsive and works on smartphones and tablets. You can upload files
from your mobile device and print to compatible wireless printers or save as PDF on mobile.

The interface automatically adapts to smaller screens, making it easy to preview and print documents
on the go. This is particularly useful when you need to print something from your phone or tablet to
a nearby printer.

Is Print-File.com really free?

Yes, Print-File.com is completely free to use with no hidden fees, subscriptions, or premium tiers.
All features are available to everyone at no cost.

The service is supported by non-intrusive ads, which help us keep the tool free and accessible for
everyone. You can print as many documents as you need without any restrictions or watermarks.

Can I print multiple pages from a PDF?

Yes! When you upload a multi-page PDF, Print-File.com displays a preview of the first page, but when

## **About Our Company**

Thermal Star ® Paper Roll is a registered trademark of Shenzhen Sailing Paper Products Co., Ltd., a
leading manufacturer and supplier of paper rolls in China. Sailing Group includes subsidiaries like
Evergreen and Petra under its umbrella. For over 19 years, we have been industry leaders in paper
roll manufacturing, with countless satisfied customers.

We produce a wide range of thermal paper and thermal label products for various applications,
including airline tickets, lottery paper, ECG paper, ATM paper, and A4 labels. Our products are used
in diverse markets such as retail supermarkets, hotels, logistics, gaming, and many others.
Currently, our company boasts over 100 employees, 40 advanced slitting machines, 10 die-cutting
machines, and 5 printing presses. These resources enable us to provide high-quality products to our
customers quickly and efficiently.

An exciting and important aspect of this industry is the continuous daily use of thermal paper in
millions of locations—this can bring you significant and sustained profits. Our unique advantage is
that, by purchasing directly from the thermal paper roll manufacturer, our prices are at least 5% to
10% lower than those of other thermal paper suppliers!

## Got Questions about Music Distribution? 

### Which streaming platforms do you distribute to?

+

Our digital music distribution service distributes to all the major streaming services: Spotify,
Apple Music, TikTok, YouTube, Deezer, Tidal and 200+ other streaming platforms and stores globally.

### What makes this platform different from other music distribution platforms?

+

We offer free accounts to verified artists who what proven industry traction. This is a strict
application process though our A&R team who review every single applicant.

Why do we do this? 
- We are actively combating streaming fraud in the the music industry
- To ensure that no bad actors get access to our system and take advantage of the tools we offer
- To promote good practices within the music industry
- We want to be proud of all of the music that we distribute and work on at Unchained Music.  

### How do I transfer my catalog from another music distributor?

+

Transferring your catalog from another music distribution service is simple. Before you start,
you’ll need a few key pieces of information, including:
‍

• The UPC and ISRC (these help DSPs identify your existing release);
• Release title and track title(s);Artist(s) name(s);
• The Original Release date and;
• The exact same audio and cover art files from the previous release.

This is the same process for almost every digital music distribution company.

### Are there any fees and do I keep all my royalties?

+

For immediate access to the platform there is a base subscription fee. Artists and labels keep all
there royalties.

For a highly select group of artists we offer free use of our platform, but this at the discretion
of the A&R team. Artists and labels under this core plan also keep 100% of their royalties.

Our unchained partners are all subject to custom deals for our artist and label services.

### Do you offer playlisting or marketing support?

+

Yes - we offer full artists and label services to a select artists. You can find out more [here][68]
